name: STREAM-WDISTILL-0S
note: Executable projection of the booked prose pre-reg (RESULTS L31503) and its four pre-look amendments (-0S-DESIGN, -0S-CONTROL, -0S-SPEC, -0S-METRIC). Written at driver-build time, BEFORE the run fired; the prose entry remains the registration of record. BAR 3's all-three conjunct became executable via the schema's conjuncts field (added pre-look, 2026-08-16, before the run's receipt was read).

S1-T.description: ternary max-anchored {-1,0,+1}, block 128, E8M0 round-up scale — the true minimal repair of EXEC1 arm A

S1-U4.description: 4-level uniform mid-rise {-1,-1/3,+1/3,+1}, nearest, ties away from zero, same block/scale

S2.description: globally optimal 4-level scalar on the frozen 4096-bin empirical discretization (exact DP over (count,sum,sumsq), fp16-representable levels), per projection, same block/scale

W4.description: residual VQ width 4, K=256, 1 stage, per-projection Lloyd-trained codebook, 2.000 index bpw

W8.description: residual VQ width 8, K=256, 2 stages, 2.000 index bpw

W32.description: residual VQ width 32, K=256, 8 stages, 2.000 index bpw

W32-shuf.description: three frozen locality-destroying twins of W32 (shuffle seeds 20260816/17/18, independent per-block permutations, each with its OWN codebook trained on its shuffled sample)

S-best.description: derived: argmin pooled operator error over {S1-T, S1-U4, S2} — the best realizable scalar

bars.name: VQ-SURVIVES
bars.description: (S_best - W32)/S_best pooled operator error >= 10%: the EXEC1 VQ advantage survives a fair scalar baseline

bars.name: VECTOR-STRUCTURE-PAYS
bars.description: (S2 - W4)/S2 pooled operator error >= 10% at exactly 2.000 index bpw both sides: multidimensional coding pays over the optimal scalar

bars.name: LOCALITY-IS-REAL
bars.description: (mean_shuffled - natural)/mean_shuffled pooled operator error >= 5%, AND natural beats each of the three twins individually (the three conjunct measurements are per-twin relative gains, each required above 0); if it does not fire, 'locally highly compressible' is not used at all

refuted_if: The best realizable scalar lands within 5% of W32 on pooled operator error — the EXEC1 headline was an artifact of a weak (ternary, over-budget) scalar arm and the 'VQ wins' reading is withdrawn.
registered_prior: House: BAR 1 MISSES and BAR 2 MISSES — the fair scalar baseline closes most of the 0.350-v-0.770 gap (confidence medium-high on BAR 1 missing, medium on BAR 2). The rate-distortion justification for this prior was RETRACTED in -0S-DESIGN (3); the prediction stands as empirical. No registered prior on BAR 3.
